name: Mega Fortris Berhad
overview: 2026年公司终止了与 V.S. International Group Limited 于2024年签署的谅解备忘录，该备忘录涉及潜在合作事项，终止后双方互不追索。此外，其他公告主要涉及诉讼、委员会人事变动及市场活动提醒等事项。
overview_en: In 2026, the company terminated the Memorandum of Understanding with V.S. International Group Limited signed in 2024, which related to potential cooperation, with no claims between the parties upon termination. Additionally, the company proposed to renew the existing shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions and proposed a variation of the utilisation of proceeds raised from its IPO.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note_en: Company-level matters include termination of an MOU, proposed renewal of related party transaction mandate, and variation of IPO proceeds utilisation.

actions.title: MEGA FORTRIS BERHAD ("Mega Fortris" or "the Company") - PROPOSED RENEWAL OF EXISTING SHAREHOLDERS' MANDATE FOR RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANS
actions.text: 以进行具有收入或交易性质的经常性关联交易。
actions.text_en: The company proposed to renew the existing shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED VARIATION OF THE UTILISATION OF PROCEEDS RAISED FROM THE INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING OF MEG
actions.text_en: The company issued a circular to shareholders in relation to the proposed variation of the utilisation of proceeds raised from its initial public offering (IPO).

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公司与 V.S. International Group Limited 双方于2026年1月6日同意终止2024年1月18日签署的谅解备忘录，终止后双方互不追索，且不会对公司产生重大财务影响。
actions.text_en: The company and V.S. International Group Limited mutually agreed on 6 January 2026 to terminate the Memorandum of Understanding signed on 18 January 2024;
